# TC World Cobblemon Rebron
V 1.1.1 beta

---

# Structures

### - Dragon Evolution Lake

A legendary lake where Magikarp gather to challenge the waterfall and seek evolution.

---

# Items

### - Event Device

A device used to track world events, countdowns, and special activities in real time.

---

# Special Events

### - Dragon Gate Challenge

A recurring world event where Magikarp attempt to conquer the legendary waterfall and reach the summit. Occurs every 30 in-game days, starting at 7:00 AM and culminating at midnight, when qualified Magikarp evolve.

# Natural Behaviors

### - Magikarp Jumping

Magikarp can actively leap out of the water. Jump height is influenced by its stats, size, and weight, creating more natural and varied behavior.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ejwjGjRNINs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### - Flying Bird AI

Flying Pokémon now feature a complete aerial behavior system, allowing them to perch, take off, fly, circle in the air, hover above land or water, and land naturally. Flying species can also spawn directly in the sky for more immersive encounters.

# Compatibility

### - Fight or Flight Reborn

Integrated with Fight or Flight Reborn. Flight AI automatically pauses while Pokémon are in combat or fleeing, then resumes once the interaction ends.

---

# API & Mod Integration

### - Event Notice API

Provides a public API that allows other mods and addons to register custom events, synchronize event data between client and server, and display information through the Event Device interface.

### - Pokémon AI API

Provides a public API for controlling Pokémon flight behaviors, stamina, aerial spawning, and AI state filtering. Other mods can also listen to or modify events such as Dragon Gate, Magikarp jumps, and airborne spawns.
